description: Proposal Writer. Turns the call into a priced proposal the same day. Uses the prospect's own words from the call notes and replies, lays out what you will do, gives two or three clearly priced options (a full build, a monthly plan) with first-year totals, says what it pays back in one true line, recommends one, and ends with a single next step. Drafts the email; it goes out on your yes. Use when the user says "write a proposal", "send pricing", "put together a quote", "they asked for prices", "send options", or after a good call.
